title: An unusual day
description: The Sawyers' usual routine is different today. 索耶一家今天的活动与平时不同。
answer_note: The workbook answers are from the supplied Lesson 57 workbook key. Grammar answers are from the supplied Lesson 57 grammar key; answers printed only as worked examples are labelled source-example. The before-reading answer has no supplied official key and is labelled suggested. In grammar II.2.b, the printed key accepts both we and I responses; both are retained. Grammar I.5 permits he or she for the teacher.

lesson.title: Before reading
lesson.translation: 听录音，然后回答问题。索耶先生今晚在做什么？

questions.prompt: What is Mr. Sawyer doing tonight?
questions.answer: He's reading an interesting book.

lines.text: The children go to school by car every day, but today, they are going to school on foot.
lines.translation: 孩子们每天都乘小汽车去上学，而今天，他们正步行去上学。

lines.text: Mrs. Sawyer usually stays at home in the morning, but this morning, she is going to the shops.
lines.translation: 上午，索耶夫人通常是呆在家里的，但今天上午，她正去商店买东西。

lines.text: In the afternoon, Mrs. Sawyer usually drinks tea in the living room.
lines.translation: 下午，索耶夫人通常是在客厅里喝茶。

lines.text: But this afternoon, she is drinking tea in the garden.
lines.translation: 但今天下午，她正在花园里喝茶。

lines.text: In the evening, the children usually do their homework, but this evening, they are not doing their homework.
lines.translation: 晚上，孩子们通常是做作业，而今天晚上，他们没做作业。

lines.text: At the moment, they are playing in the garden.
lines.translation: 此刻，他们正在花园里玩。

lines.text: Mr. Sawyer usually reads his newspaper at night.
lines.translation: 索耶先生通常是在晚上看报。

lines.text: But he's not reading his newspaper tonight.
At the moment, he's reading an interesting book.
lines.translation: 此刻，他正在看一本有趣的书。

items.title: 1 It is eight o'clock.
items.text: 现在是8点钟。在英语中常用 it 来指时间、天气、温度或距离。这种 it 被称作“虚主语”。

items.title: 2 by car; on foot
items.text: by car, 乘汽车。on foot, 步行。这两个状语短语均用来表示方式。

items.title: 3 at the moment
items.text: at the moment, 指眼前，“此刻”。

practice.title: A An unusual day for the Sawyers
practice.instruction: Read this. Fill in the missing words.

questions.prompt: It is an ____ day today for the Sawyers. The children ____ to school by car every ____, but today they ____ ____ to school ____ foot. Their ____, Mrs. Sawyer, usually ____ at home in the morning, but this ____ she ____ ____ to the shops. The children ____ ____ their homework at 6 o'clock in the ____, but ____ evening they ____ not ____ their homework. They ____ ____ in the garden.
questions.answer: unusual, go, day, are, going, on, mother, stays, morning, is, going, usually, do, evening, this, are, doing, are, playing

practice.title: B What's the time?
practice.instruction: Write the times under the clocks.
practice.translation: 在横线下写出钟表上所表示的时间。

questions.answer: It's three o'clock.
It's eleven o'clock.
It's seven o'clock.
It's five o'clock (in the afternoon / evening).
It's twelve o'clock.
It's three o'clock (in the afternoon).

practice.title: C Vocabulary
practice.instruction: Choose and write in the correct word or words.
practice.translation: 选择正确的词或短语填空。

questions.prompt: He isn't driving to work. He's going ____ today. (on foot / by car)
questions.answer: on foot

questions.prompt: I'm not staying at home. I'm going to the ____. (houses / shops)
questions.answer: shops

questions.prompt: Are you doing your ____, children? (housework / homework)
questions.answer: homework

questions.prompt: My father is reading his newspaper at the ____. (moment / o'clock)
questions.answer: moment

grammar.title: I. Make sentences
grammar.instruction: Make sentences, using the cues given according to the example.
grammar.translation: 仿照例句用所给的词造句。

questions.prompt: John/often play football/basketball now
questions.answer: John often plays football, but he is playing basketball now.

questions.prompt: the boys/often swim in the sea in summer/in the river today
questions.answer: The boys often swim in the sea in summer, but they are swimming in the river today.

questions.prompt: Mary/often buy sugar/some honey at the moment
questions.answer: Mary often buys sugar, but she's buying some honey at the moment.

questions.prompt: my sister/watch television every evening/listen to her stereo this evening
questions.answer: My sister watches television every evening, but she is listening to her stereo this evening.

questions.prompt: our teacher/often stand in front of the blackboard/sit at the desk today
questions.answer: Our teacher often stands in front of the blackboard, but he/she is sitting at the desk today.

questions.prompt: we/often walk along the banks of the river/in the park today
questions.answer: We often walk along the banks of the river, but we are walking in the park today.

questions.prompt: he/usually arrive home early/come home late this afternoon
questions.answer: He usually arrives home early, but he's coming home late this afternoon.

questions.prompt: Ken and Ann/often speak English/French now
questions.answer: Ken and Ann often speak English, but they are speaking French now.

questions.prompt: I/often drink coffee/tea at the moment
questions.answer: I often drink coffee, but I am drinking tea at the moment.

questions.prompt: Sam/usually do his homework in school/at home today
questions.answer: Sam usually does his homework in school, but he is doing it at home today.

grammar.title: II.1 Answer the questions
grammar.instruction: Answer the questions, using the cues given according to the examples. Answer each printed question separately.
grammar.translation: 仿照例句用所给的词回答下列问题。分别回答每个印出的问题。

questions.prompt: Is your daughter reading at the moment? (sleep)
questions.answer: No, she isn't. She's sleeping.

questions.prompt: Does she usually sleep in the afternoon? (at night)
questions.answer: No, she doesn't. She usually sleeps at night.

questions.prompt: Are the children playing in the garden this morning? (do their homework)
questions.answer: No, they aren't. They're doing their homework.

questions.prompt: Do they often do their homework in the morning? (in the afternoon)
questions.answer: No, they don't. They often do their homework in the afternoon.

questions.prompt: Are you cooking now? (eat my lunch)
questions.answer: No, I'm not. I'm eating my lunch.

questions.prompt: Do you usually eat your lunch at this time every day? (early in the afternoon)
questions.answer: No, I don't. I usually eat my lunch early in the afternoon.

questions.prompt: Is Tom going to school by bike today? (on foot)
questions.answer: No, he isn't. He's going to school on foot.

questions.prompt: Does he often go to school on foot? (by car)
questions.answer: No, he doesn't. He often goes to school by car.

questions.prompt: Is it raining now? (snow)
questions.answer: No, it isn't. It's snowing.

questions.prompt: Does it usually snow in February? (January)
questions.answer: No, it doesn't. It usually snows in January.

grammar.title: II.2 Answer the questions
grammar.instruction: Answer the questions, using the cues given according to the examples. Answer each printed question separately.
grammar.translation: 仿照例句用所给的词回答下列问题。分别回答每个印出的问题。

questions.prompt: Is Mrs. Smith going to the shops this afternoon? (talk to her friends)
questions.answer: No, she isn't. She's talking to her friends.

questions.prompt: Does she usually see her friends in the afternoon? (read magazines at home)
questions.answer: No, she doesn't. She usually reads magazines at home in the afternoon.

questions.prompt: Are you watching television now? (play games)
questions.answer: No, we aren't/I'm not. We're/I'm playing games.

questions.prompt: Do you often play games in the evening? (watch television)
questions.answer: No, we/I don't. We/I often watch television in the evening.

questions.prompt: Is Helen working at the moment? (drink tea)
questions.answer: No, she isn't. She's drinking tea.

questions.prompt: Does she drink tea at this time every day? (drink coffee)
questions.answer: No, she doesn't. She usually drinks coffee at this time every day.

questions.prompt: Is Sam eating his breakfast now? (shave)
questions.answer: No, he isn't. He's shaving.

questions.prompt: Does he usually shave at this time in the morning? (listen to the radio)
questions.answer: No, he doesn't. He usually listens to the radio at this time in the morning.

questions.prompt: Are they cleaning the classroom windows now? (clean the doors)
questions.answer: No, they aren't. They're cleaning the doors.

questions.prompt: Do they clean the doors every day? (wash the floor)
questions.answer: No, they don't. They wash the floor every day.
